articles.title: Xbox is launching a new film and TV division
articles.description: Xbox is launching a new division, called "XP," that's dedicated to Xbox experiences that aren't video games, including films and TV adaptations, consumer products, live events, and partnerships with creators and brands. articles.description: Cupertino brings the tech backlash to the CBS procedural - an initially awkward combination, but with rewarding results.
